title: Working on a multiplayer horror game called The Darkness
author: ProfMags
selftext:
This is a game I've been working on for a little while with Opus 5.5, called **The Darkness**.

The basic premise is that players spawn into one of five different maps, where their objective is to restore power and get the evacuation doors open so they can escape. The catch is that they're being hunted by a creature known as the Beast.

The Beast can see in the dark and has four unique abilities, but it can't directly sense where players are. Players will need to use stealth, work together, and be careful not to give away their positions.

Throughout the maps, players can search different props and containers for weapons, gear, and useful survival items such as noisemakers, glow sticks, and flares. There are also various hiding spots, allowing players to hide inside lockers, under beds, in crates, and other places to avoid being caught by the Beast.

There are still quite a few rough edges, and some of the animations are a little wonky. The gun animations in particular need a lot of work, and I'll be adjusting those myself since they honestly look pretty awful right now. There's still plenty of polishing to do, but I wanted to share what I've been working on!
